keySentence: Children see what grown-ups forget — the world is wonderful.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Alice's adventure ended. She was not afraid to ask why. The world is full of wonder. Children see what grown-ups forget the world is wonderful.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Alice's adventure in Wonderland was over but its lessons stayed. She learned to question rules and never accept unfair things. Adults say that is just how things are without thinking deeply. Children see what grown-ups forget, that the world is wonderful. Alice showed us that asking why is the beginning of all wisdom. Let us keep our curious eyes open and never stop wondering.
facts.Word cards: wonderful = 경이로운 / the world = 세상 / lesson = 교훈 / magic = 마법
